subject.title: feat(session): add chat-channel session switching with LRU history retention

question: Which chat-session command contract should OpenClaw accept before any open `/sessions` or `/resume` PR can merge?
rationale: The implementation overlaps an open `/resume` PR and changes persisted session state, auth/provider continuity, and user-visible chat command behavior, so automation cannot choose the product contract safely.

options.title: Choose the canonical contract first
options.body: Use the open tracker to decide `/sessions` versus `/resume`, then require the chosen candidate to repair the session-boundary findings and provide real chat proof.

options.title: Sponsor this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate but require conflict resolution, full boundary repair, cleanup-reference coverage, and redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for a replacement
options.body: Leave this PR blocked until a smaller proven replacement branch exists, then close this one as superseded.

recommendation.title: Choose the canonical contract first
recommendation.body: Use the open tracker to decide `/sessions` versus `/resume`, then require the chosen candidate to repair the session-boundary findings and provide real chat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main session lifecycle and session-state history points to steipete as the best available owner for this command and boundary decision.
